# O'Connell St Madrid

> O'Connell St is an Irish pub and sports bar at Calle de Espoz y Mina 7, 28012 Madrid, Spain, a short walk from Puerta del Sol. Its focus is European football: Premier League, UEFA Champions League and LaLiga on a projector and 9 screens. Basketball, rugby, Formula 1 and tennis are also shown when broadcast.

ES: O'Connell St es un pub irlandés y bar deportivo en Calle de Espoz y Mina 7, 28012 Madrid, junto a Puerta del Sol, centrado en el fútbol europeo (Premier League, Champions League y LaLiga). Web en español: https://oconnellsmadrid.es/es

## Key facts
- Name: O'Connell St (O'Connell St Madrid)
- Type: Irish pub and sports bar
- Address: Calle de Espoz y Mina, 7, 28012 Madrid, Spain
- Nearest station: Sol (Metro and Cercanías)
- How to recognise it: red facade with gold O'CONNELL ST. lettering
- Opening hours (Madrid time): Mon–Thu 18:00–03:00; Fri 16:00–03:30; Sat 15:00–03:30; Sun 14:00–03:00
- Contact: comunicacion@oconnellsmadrid.es or the contact form (https://oconnellsmadrid.es/contact)
- Google Maps: https://maps.google.com/maps?cid=10697659365903665225
- Match listings: confirmed games for the next 7 days are on What's On, always in Madrid time
